front.label: Front
front.desc: Your name, your number out of 25, the two brands, and the Hyperliquid mark grown large from your namehash.

front.label: Number
front.desc: Your number out of 25 in a tall serif numerator, a thin mint slash and a small denominator. It is set when your card is confirmed.

front.label: Name
front.desc: Your .hl or .eth name, the only mark on the face that is not a brand or a number. The ending is filled in mint.

front.label: The mark
front.desc: The Hyperliquid mark at full size, filled with our India illustration in black and white and banknote lace grown from your namehash. No two cards share the lace.

front.label: Encoded HYPE
front.desc: The word HYPE is cut deeper into the lace, so it reads from across the room and changes as the light moves across the metal.

front.label: Brands
front.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS, the two parties behind the card, in black and white.

back.label: Back
back.desc: The key to the front: how the lace on the other side was grown from this name, and how to verify it.

back.label: Key to the front
back.desc: The seed curve of the lace and the five numbers that shape it: ring, gear, pen, petals and turn, each read from a byte of your namehash.

back.label: Namehash, 256 bits
back.desc: Every bit of your namehash, filled for 1 and open for 0. The first fifteen bytes, outlined in mint, are the ones that grow the lace.

back.label: Register
back.desc: Scan to open this name's record in the ENS or Hyperliquid Names app, or tap the card.

back.label: Bearer, redacted
back.desc: Your name in full. The wallet is shown only by its ends and the rest is redacted into the metal; full values resolve onchain.

back.label: How to read it
back.desc: Same name, same lace, and no two cards match. The genesis record and HYPE token id tie the card to the day it was issued against.

back.label: Serial
back.desc: Your number out of 25, large, at the foot, matching the front.
